description: The plot illustrates how loss ratio (in percent) varies with compute measured in TFLOPs for several SepLLM configurations. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 1e7 to 9e8 with tick labels at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale, and ranges from 94 to 100 with integer tick marks. A purple solid line with triangle markers stays flat at 100% across all x-values. An orange solid line with plus markers (SepLLM (n=64)) starts near 98.3% at 1e7, rises to about 99.0% at 5e7 and about 100.0% at 2e8, peaks around 100.4% at 4e8, and ends near 99.9% at 9e8 with small fluctuations around 100% from 5e8 onward. A blue solid line with “x” markers (SepLLM (n=128)) begins around 97.0% at 1e7, increases to about 99.1% at 5e7 and about 99.9% at 2e8, then stays close to 100% with slight dips, ending around 99.8% at 9e8. A green solid line with diamond markers (SepLLM (n=64, H)) starts near 97.5% at 1e7, climbs to about 99.1% at 5e7 and about 99.9% at 2e8, reaches about 100.0% at 4e8–5e8, shows a small high point around 100.2% at 6e8, and finishes near 99.9% at 9e8. A red solid line with circle markers (SepLLM (n=64, H/T)) begins around 94.0% at 1e7, rises to about 97.2% at 5e7 and about 98.5% at 2e8, reaches about 99.1% at 4e8, dips to about 98.5% at 5e8, returns to about 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ends around 98.7% at 9e8.
